question: Which disease is caused by NOT having enough vitamin C in the diet for at least 3 months leading to weakness, anaemia, gum disease and skin problems?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Scurvy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Scurvy is caused due to deficiency of Vitamin C.
 
• Scurvy causes gum disease, general weakness, skin haemorrhages, and anaemia.
 
• The sources of Vitamin C are citrus fruits and vegetables.
 
• Diseases that occur due to lack of nutrients over a long period are called deficiency diseases.
 
• Each vitamin has a specific function and its deficiency leads to a particular deficiency disease.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Vitamin
 Deficiency disease
 Symptoms
